'''Haruna Yakubu''' (born 24 October 1955) is a Vice-Chancellor of [[University for Development Studies]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Past Vice-Chancellors - University for Development Studies |url=https://www.uds.edu.gh/about/past-vice-chancellors/ |access-date=2023-09-12 |website=www.uds.edu.gh |archive-date=2023-10-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231014212118/https://www.uds.edu.gh/about/past-vice-chancellors/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Education ==
He obtained a Master of Science degree in Physics and Mathematics in 1984 and a Doctor of Philosophy degree in Semiconductor Physics in 1992, both at [[Moldova State University]], [[Chișinău]], [[Moldova]] ([[Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic|Moldavian SSR]] until 1991).<ref>{{cite web|title=PROF. YAKUBU HARUNA- VICE-CHANCELLOR OF UDS|url=http://old.uds.edu.gh/vcprofile.php|publisher=UDS Website|accessdate=20 March 2015|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130902203333/http://old.uds.edu.gh/vcprofile.php|archivedate=2 September 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=9 April 2002|title=New Vice Chancellor for UDS|url=http://www.modernghana.com/news/21767/1/new-vice-chancellor-for-uds.html|work=Ghana News Agency|publisher=Modern Ghana|accessdate=31 March 2014}}</ref>

== Career ==
Previous appointments include  Pro-Vice Chancellor of the [[University of Cape Coast]], Chairman of the Governing Council of the Centre for Renewable Energy Studies (CRES), executive member – Ghana Solar Energy Society, fellow – Council for Advancement and Support for Education-UK, Associate Member – [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP), and Member – Governing Council of the Foundation for Security and Development in Africa (FOSOA).
